name: [🌵] Grow a Tree!
desc:
Ready to grow the tallest TREE?🌳🌴🌵

🍃 Equip the sapling you wanna plant!
🛤️ Click on the soil in your land to plant it!
🌲 Watch it sprout and grow over time!
🤑 Once it’s fully grown, harvest it for wood to sell for BUX!!!

And don’t forget — your forest keeps growing into a Forest even while you're offline 🌟

LIKE AND FAVOURITE THE GAME FOR MORE UPDATES !!
